items.note: The plan gives the subtract/add/restore eight-row schedule, which makes the net change independent of the scratch values; the central coefficients |S∩T| mod 2 and (|S∩T|-1)/2 with side-wire cancellation; and the three-stage composition (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x). This is the proof at 741-764. h=100 and the wire counts W_b, W_c are not given.

It states D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1} and the route operator eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1} on every role, auxiliary roles included. It proves them by the paper's invariant: the stored array equals D_v times the logical array, and a common frame commutes with a pointwise gate.

The statement carries the nondegenerate nested labels, the only decreasing edges (central 3->4, loss h), L=Ich, Wm-2N+2L and the ratios 100/539, 101/539. The derivation covers the stage transitions, the central loss, telescoping and the orthonormal bases. It omits the gate-label table (eq:motif-labels) and the per-edge residual table, including the side-wire chain P⊗<t_X> ⊂ P⊗t_Y^⊥ that uses t_X⊥t_Y, which is what proves every edge comparable (1024-1060).

The plan follows the proof step by step: rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U; the N negative source projections give a first edge 2P_{U_a} of rank one; s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b with deficit N-2L_b>0; and the endpoint difference is P_{U_a^⊥}+P_{U_a}=I_m. The Phi_M shear frames appear in S3.3.

It has weight additivity mod 4, the odd weights of norm-one vectors, H diag(1,-1)H=X giving aI+bX_v, the k-column tensoring, the exceptional pair X_a->Y_a (C^{-1} on 27 coordinates) and its correction by C=iZC^{-1}Z, and s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c. That the full label has frame C^{⊗m} (q_F=wt) is only implied.

The chain L/N<1/2 -> positive deficits -> s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^{-50} is present, as is m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-20*2^{-50}). The exact deficits eta_b=339/22587335000000 and eta_c=73/19906842167500 and the reason log m<20 are not given, so the comparison with 20*2^{-50} is only asserted.

All four elementary operations and the controlled shift or unit scaling are stated with their O(V) costs and the b^{O(1)} offset condition. The method only cites them; no split/merge or fibre-rotation argument is given.

The shear proof is reproduced: the triangular factors are done by controlled shifts, and each one of Pi becomes D_j+=H_i, swap, D_j=H_i-D_j, giving exactly a interchanges. The factorization A=E_1 Pi E_2 is only quoted, without the elimination proof. The fixed odd prime q avoiding all denominators, needed to specialise the factors to Z/q^b, is absent.

It covers the cyclic row split into W streams of volume V/W, edges done as Phi_{A_e} by recursive interchanges, the physical output Phi_{I_m}, the three-update interchange, s calls, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) with the geometric-sum case split, and the depth-first parking schedule. This matches 1491-1616.

The plan has the row field of rho=O(log e) high digits padded to a multiple of W^k, the base-m pieces with cost O(V)sum a_j m^{j tau}=O(Ve^tau), and padding to [q^e]. It omits the step that first interchanges the high digits pair by pair and joins h^+ after d^+ (and later separates them), without which the top digits are never exchanged.

It gives the edge product of C_{v_j}^{eps_j}, conjugation by P_M with one child on slot h per direction, (C^{-1})^{⊗f}=(-i)^f Z C Z for inverses, exactly s_c children on e/m axes, and H_0^{⊗D}=b^D S_D C^{⊗D} S_D. That M is a fixed product of row additions is only implicit in S4.6.5.

Present: the eight additions, the guard interval 10<=g<=2^{K-1}-11, delta_bad=min{1,80(f-1)2^{-K}}, repair by radix sorting and the slot application. Missing from the statement: the lemma's time bound (eq:packed-rectangle-time) and its asymptotic hypotheses. Missing from the derivation: the up to sixteen chunk swaps that put the target after its controls (the source of L^tau) and the separate XOR at the top position j_{f-1}.

It has the node overhead O(V((eK)^tau+1)), the q_0 preprocessed chunks as row index, the split u=Wg+w giving 1/W child volumes, and the recurrence with leaves O(e). The unrolling gives internal O(e^lambda), leaves O(e^sigma d^{beta(1-sigma)}) and the base-m pieces O(d^{lambda'}). Padding rows to a multiple of W^{k_0} and the layer's stack schedule are not mentioned.

It states Q_p(Hz) in O(Vd^{lambda'}) with error below sqrt2 2^{-p}, exact evaluation with one final truncation, and the guard width from A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E, A(e)<=8B^2 d^{nu+1}, C_0 d^{C_1}=o(p). The proof's check that the packed-call extra terms vanish uniformly is not repeated here.

Character cancellation, decimation in frequency with bit reversal, the reversed rounds, the grouping into H then J_E, the prefix moves, the chunk exchanges, the layer cost and LBF^-, F^+B^{-1}L^{-1} are all there. The error bound sqrt2 l 2^{-p} is not derived: the argument that J_E commutes with Q_p, so each contraction round is truncated once, is missing.

It has B_0=2^{4p} evaluation, the four products by the established multiplier, the separation |h_j|<=r2^{2p}<B_0/2 for centred residues, and negacyclic reduction with |H_j|<=r2^{2p}. This follows 3233-3368, though the returned Q_p(fg/r) is left implicit.

It has two forward transforms kept in LB order, the pointwise product commuting with LB, the normalisation identity F^-(f*g)=M F^-f F^-g, the error 3delta+eta scaled by M to sqrt2 M(3l+1)2^{-p}, and the cost with log(rp).

The identity P_sF_s=2^{2alpha^2}B_0P_tF_tA, the hypothesis theta>p/alpha^4, the error and time bounds and the tensor form with gamma=2d alpha^2 are stated. The permutations P_s, P_t are never defined. The route (TP_sF_s=P_tF_tS, Neumann inverse of N, normalised contractions, line-wise tensoring and axis exposure) is the paper's.

It has the chirp's period using even t_i, the coefficient check giving QF_t u = abar·(a*(abar·u))/T, F^+R_c=R_c^{-1}F^+ for units so that RF^+R=F^+, and cancellation to (u*v)/S^2. Conjugation for RF^+ appears in S8.1.3.

All fixed rationals, the sizes, alpha, gamma, eta, the prime count, T/2<S<T, alpha^4 theta_i>p, the trial-division cost and the no-wraparound check are given as in the paper. Absent: the verification that the chosen exponents satisfy the layer and margin conditions (4018-4036) and the fixing of the comparison constants a_d, b_d, a_r, b_r (4073-4088).

It has the isomorphism from x^S=1 and the order-S image, the triangular formula b_i=a_i+mu_i sum_{j<i}a_jP_j, updates from i=d down as prefix-controlled cyclic shifts fixing the padding, and the O(Tpd^2(1+l^tau)) cost.

The exact twist is derived as in 4298-4347: well defined, diagonal and isometric, with the wrap check zeta^{k+l}(-1)^h=zeta^j, and M_C=D_-iota^{-1}M_r(iota D_+f, iota D_+g)=(f*g)/T. For the computed version (4349-4413) the plan only lists the sequence, without the twist approximations' error, the format matching or the O(Tp^{1+delta}) cost.

It has the source transform (A, then chirp via twist and convolution, then B_0, then scale 2^gamma) with exact counterpart RF_s and its conjugate opposite, and the six steps with digits scaled by 2^{-b-2}. The two occurrences of S are explained as undoing (u*v)/S^2.

E_s=9·2^gamma TL, the product error (2E_s+2), E_w<28·2^gamma T^2 L, the final bound 448b 2^{-3b/4}<1/2, rounding and the carry invariant follow the paper. The first links (E_ring=M(3L+2)<5TL and the twist and endpoint contributions giving the chirp bound 8TL) are only quoted, not derived.

It gives the cost table normalised by Tp, the margins g_1..g_7 with min 2^{-181}=2kappa, setup and exceptional sorting as o(Tp), polylog absorption, O(n(log n)^{1-kappa}), and the schoolbook cutoff. This is the paper's route.
Only the dependency name nlogn-conjecture in S0's relies-on list. No step states what an eventual lower bound means or that the liminf of T_A(n)/(n lg n) is zero.

errors.says: In both label fields every triple line is nondegenerate and neighbouring lines are orthogonal 'since <t_S,t_T>=|S∩T|-1'.
errors.paper: The formula |S∩T|-1 holds only for the rational form x^T(I-J/9)y of the bit network. For the complex network the form is the F_2 dot product, t_S·t_T=|S∩T| mod 2 with t_T·t_T=1, and neighbours there have even intersection.

errors.says: Peel off the top rho digits of each chunk as a row index, interchange the remaining base-m pieces by the power-width procedure, then undo the padding.
errors.paper: The high digits are first interchanged pair by pair and h^+ is joined after d^+ to form the row field (d^+,h^+). The joining moves are reversed at the end. Without this step the top rho digits would not be exchanged.

errors.says: Because the Gaussian window has radius ceil(sqrt p) alpha, the quoted maps S', J', D' each cost O(tp^{3/2+delta} alpha).
errors.paper: The costs come from cited lemmas, with D' costing O(tp^{1+delta}). The window radius concerns only the tape movement of the S' procedure.

chain: The tree reaches O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}) by the paper's route. It goes from the two fixed networks, the subspace labels and the rank and phase interfaces to s<Wm and tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}; then to the shear-based interchange recurrence and the phase-frame layer recurrence; then to synthetic transforms and ring convolution, resampling with retained permutations, chirp and cancellation, sizes, primes, CRT and twist; and finally to exact recovery and the margin table. It thins out where the paper's verification is detailed: the per-edge residual table proving every label edge nested, the proof of the triangular factorization, the high-digit exchange in the arbitrary-width reduction, the chunk swaps inside packed addition, and the early links of the error chain (ring, twist, chirp).

steps.note: It has banks indexed by triples of 3-subsets, m=10^6, a fixed linear network giving (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a), and restoration of every scratch value. h=100 and N=binom(h,3)^3 are not written out; they are implicit in m=10^6 and in the N used by the budget.
It has a common invertible frame per gate commuting with the pointwise gate, the implemented operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and edges costing D_v D_u^{-1}.
It has nondegenerate subspace labels of an m-dimensional tensor space, comparable labels on every edge, and the central wires 3->4 as the only decreasing edges, each losing h.
It has rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U for nested labels, with the N source edges (first edge matrix 2P_{U_a}) as the rank-one exceptions.
It has the sum of |Δdim|=Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, and adding the N source ranks gives s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b.
It has L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2, so the deficits N-2L_b and 2N-2L_c are positive and s<Wm.
It has M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m on every role, so the bit network applies H<-H+D on every row, scratch rows included.
It has A=E_1 Pi E_2, exactly a interchanges plus O(V) per edge shear done recursively, and s recursive calls per node.

It has children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), deficits above 20*2^{-50} with m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-20*2^{-50}) giving s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50}, and F_k=O(e^tau). log m<20 is used only implicitly, through that inequality.

central.summary: P08 reconstructs all nine steps of the central saving in order. They run from the triple-indexed bank-exchange network and frames, through the nested labels whose dimension changes equal edge ranks, the budget Wm-2N+2L with L/N<1/2, and the endpoint identity giving the shear, to the matrix-shear edge calls and the recurrence with s/W<m^tau, tau=1-2^{-50}. Only h=100, N and the reason log m<20 are left implicit.
